name: Changes Filter

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_code_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_code_changes }}
      has_content_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_content_changes }}
      has_dependency_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_dependency_changes }}
      has_seo_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_seo_changes }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Filter changes
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          filters: |
            has_code_changes:
              - 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'
              - 'lib/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'
              - 'packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'
              - 'test/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'
              - 'tests/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'
              - '__tests__/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'
              - '*.config.{js,ts,mjs,cjs}'
              - 'tsconfig.json'
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'yarn.lock'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
            has_content_changes:
              - 'content/**/*'
              - 'docs/**/*'
              - '*.md'
              - '*.mdx'
            has_dependency_changes:
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'yarn.lock'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
            has_seo_changes:
              - 'content/**/*'
              - 'public/**/*'
              - 'src/**/seo/**/*'
              - 'src/**/meta/**/*'
              - 'next-sitemap.config.js'
              - 'next.config.js'
              - 'next.config.ts'
